title: Enzyme Engine — Enzymes & Vitamins
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B enzymes (Chapter 11) in six modes: Classify the Enzyme (the six classes from a reaction), Spot the Inhibitor (competitive, noncompetitive, irreversible, heavy metals, feedback and denaturation from active-site pictures), Read the Plot (activity versus temperature, pH, substrate and enzyme concentration), Cofactors & Vitamins (B vitamins to coenzymes, deficiency diseases, metal-ion cofactors), Regulation & Clinic (feedback, zymogens, covalent modification, blood enzyme tests, fluoride and disinfectants), and Exam Practice (79 Final Boss enzyme questions).
